timestamp_limitation: Original start/end timestamps were not recorded. This summary does not reconstruct them.
failures: Empty own timetable incorrectly returned source-changed instead of a successful empty result
Four stale-source cases incorrectly returned source-changed instead of source-stale
root_cause: On Windows/Python 3.14, fstat and Path.stat exposed different ctime meanings for a stable overwritten file. Comparing their ctime_ns fields caused a false change detection.
fix: Compare device, inode, size and modification time; recheck after validation. Added a repeated stable-overwrite regression.
sanitization: Assertion summary only; ephemeral credentials, cookies, fixture object representations and response bodies excluded.
